# Sageon Media — Web Development & Digital Solutions Agency

> Sageon Media is a modern web development agency based in Riga, Latvia, providing premium website development, e-commerce solutions, UI/UX design, custom web applications, technical SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) for clients locally and remotely worldwide.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- **Custom Website Development**: Fast, high-converting, mobile-first websites engineered with React, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS.
- **E-Commerce Solutions**: Scalable, high-performance online stores with multi-currency, Stripe/payment gateway integration, and modern shopping cart flows (starting from €2,450).
- **Technical SEO & GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)**: Optimizing websites for Google Search, PageSpeed (95+ score), Core Web Vitals, and AI search engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews).
- **UI/UX Design & Branding**: Modern user interfaces, logo design, conversion optimization, responsive micro-interactions, and visual storytelling.
- **Website Audit & Speed Optimization**: Free audits of existing websites, identifying performance bottlenecks, security flaws, and UX friction.
- **Website Maintenance & Hosting**: Continuous security updates, SSL management, automated backups, and 24/7 uptime monitoring.
